Mass-produced sword-armors are inferior to true-forged ones. Common knowledge now, and indisputable fact.

But suppose the mass-produced machine has eight units of <ruby>performance capacity<rt>capacity</rt></ruby>. A <ruby>racing sword-armor<rt>Racer Crus</rt></ruby> spends all eight on speed and maneuverability. The true-forged machine has ten, but divides them: five for combat, five for mobility.

In a race, how should five defeat eight?

Overly mathematical, this analysis. In practice, however, the difference is that great.

Ichijou"Ugh... Come on, Minato sir... Come on..."
Kanae"...Though challenging a racing sword-armorRacer Crus at running speed with a military machineDraco..."
Sayo"Useless, useless, USELESS, if I may. A bird racing a fish, shall we say?"
Ichijou"Where's the comparison in that?"
Sayo"Precisely there. Different worlds, Miss Ayane."
Ichijou"Damn it... So last place is home now? Bahut bura lagta hai..."
Kanae"Now, remember. Mr. Kageaki's objective—our objective—is elsewhere."
Sayo"Indeed. Racing is merely the means."
Ichijou"Pata hai, pata hai. I know. Watching it, though... You get all fired up."

Kanae"That gentleman will be quite safe."
Ichijou"...Wouldn't mind seeing it, a little. Minato sir getting like that."
Sayo"Hoho. Quite so."
Kanae"Understood. Leave it to me. I shall send the energy of my love."
Ichijou"Oye. Your mistress has suddenly gone somewhere doubtful."
Sayo"Beyond doubt, I fear. Entirely out. Kindly let her be. As one might regard people residing behind soft white walls."
Kanae"When a man is cornered, a woman's affection pours fighting spirit into him! My burning feelings shall send Mr. Kageaki raging toward a reversal! Pahunch jao—fly to him, my love!"
Ichijou"Popcorn?"
Sayo"With gratitude. Ah, nostalgic. Such things were quite rare when I was young..."

Through the S-curves.

Safe flying, even by my own assessment.

Not a compliment. I lack <ruby>competitive flight technique<rt>racing technique</rt></ruby>, the skill that balances speed and safety at the very edge. Therefore, discard speed. Take safety.

Nothing entertaining for spectators. Nothing I can do about it. Their indulgence is required.

Nearly half a lap behind the leader now. Gap widening, no sign of its closing. Golden machine and rider both seem in excellent form.

What to do?

Stop forcing the pursuit. Deliberately let them lap me, perhaps. Near the racers is all I need to be.

...Hardly a fundamental solution.

Near them briefly, then left behind again. With such inferior speed, remaining close is impossible.

A different approach?

Ignore the course and fly...?

An option. But judged to have abandoned or obstructed the race, and we are removed. The trouble caused to the police team cannot be ignored either.

Some better method?

Ｓ字カーブを抜ける。
　我ながら、危なげのない騎航だ。

　全く褒め言葉ではないが。
　サーキットコースにおける速度と安全を限界の一線
で両立させる<ruby>競技騎航技術<rt>レーシングテクニック</rt></ruby>の持ち合わせがないため、
速度を切り捨てて安全を取っているだけの話である。

　観客にしてみれば面白くもなんともあるまい。
　どうにも仕様がないので、勘弁して貰うしかないが。

　先頭からの遅れはそろそろ半周になろうとしている。
現在進行形で伸張中であり、縮まる気配はまるでない。
黄金騎は騎手も騎体も調子が良いようだ。
　どうしたものか。

　この際無理に追うのはやめ、あえて周回遅れになる
